author: Mark Atwood
text: Deferring out of the JMAP-ayoz review-loop frontier. The bead itself notes: 'the canonical must change first. This finding is filed against this crate because the review scope is this crate, but the fix path goes through the canonical.' Workspace-wide canonical-template change — needs its own epic, not inline in this single-crate review loop. Likely bundle with JMAP-ayoz.22 and JMAP-ayoz.36 in a workspace-wide MemoryBackend hygiene epic.
